approved.en: Russian drones have struck Ukrainian rail infrastructure, killing 13 at one station and 14 on a platform in Dnipro, while night attacks have left 350,000 people without power in the same city. Ukrainian investigators have concluded that Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians, and the EU has freed over 20 billion euros to potentially help Ukraine's defence. Germany and Ukraine are testing an armed ground robot for frontline deployment, and US pressure has led Ukraine to pause strikes on Russian oil refineries. Trump officials are discussing sanctions relief for a Russian fund, and a localized ceasefire in Oleshky has entered its third day. The conflict has caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske droner har rammet ukrainsk jernbaneinfrastruktur, og drepte 13 på en stasjon og 14 på en perrong i Dnipro, mens nattangrep har etterlatt 350 000 personer uten strøm i samme by. Ukrainas etterforskere har konkludert med at Russland har begått krigsforbrytelser ved å angripe sivile, og EU har frigitt over 20 milliarder euro som potensielt kan hjelpe Ukrainas forsvar. Tyskland og Ukraina tester en bevæpnet bakkebot for utplassering i frontlinjen, og amerikansk press har fått Ukraina til å pause angrep på russiske oljeraffinerier. Trump-tjenestemenn diskuterer lettelser i sanksjoner for et russisk fond, og en lokalisert våpenhvile i Oleshky har gått inn i sin tredje dag. Konflikten har forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the West Bank and Jewish Israeli blocs rejected Palestinian support. In Gaza, Israeli strikes this week killed 21 people, an aid group reported worsening food insecurity as operations were sharply cut, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah continues to fire rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF investigation. Lebanese olive harvests proceed under the threat of drones and warplanes, and UN peacekeepers are withdrawing from Lebanon after pressure from Israel. Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding and announced a large solar plant project for southern Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I nordlige Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drapet Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har utløst en etterforskning fra IDF. Libanons olivenhøst fortsetter under trussel fra droner og kampfly, og FN-fredsbevarere trekker seg tilbake fra Libanon etter press fra Israel. Qatar har lovet midler til gjenoppbygging og kunngjort et stort solkraftprosjekt for sørlige Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall i væpnede konflikter i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: JD Vance has sent a letter to Iran's president urging a restart of peace talks while Qatar has called on Iran to end regional threats and reopen the Strait of Hormuz as a goodwill gesture. The IRGC reports that four tankers were struck by mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's covert military network is moving hardware past the U.S. blockade. A top U.S. admiral briefed President Trump on possible attack options against Iran and the Pentagon dismissed a general accused of leaking classified information. An IDF soldier has been charged with spying for Iran in exchange for cryptocurrency, and oil prices have eased as the United States seeks renewed diplomacy with Iran. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: JD Vance har sendt et brev til Irans president og oppfordrer til å gjenoppta fredsforhandlingene, mens Qatar har oppfordret Iran til å stoppe regionale trusler og gjenåpne Hormuzstredet som en godvilje-gestus. IRGC melder at fire tankskip ble truffet av miner i Hormuzstredet, og Irans skjulte militære nettverk frakter utstyr forbi den amerikanske blokaden. En høytstående amerikansk admiral briefet president Trump om mulige angrepsalternativer mot Iran, og Pentagon avsatte en general som ble anklaget for å lekke klassifisert informasjon. En IDF-soldat er blitt siktet for spionasje for Iran i bytte mot kryptovaluta, og oljeprisene har lettet ettersom USA søker fornyet diplomati med Iran. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have stepped up attacks, striking Saudi airports and oil facilities and launching missiles toward Riyadh and the Ras Tanura refinery, while Saudi air defenses intercepted missiles over the Eastern Province. The coalition responded with airstrikes that hit a market in northern Yemen and a petrol station, causing civilian casualties, and a Saudi strike killed 12 people in a residential area. Fighting continues near Yemen’s Taiz as the UN urges humanitarian access. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Koalisjonen svarte med luftangrep som traff et marked i Nord-Jemen og en bensinstasjon, og forårsaket sivile tap, og et saudisk angrep drepte 12 personer i et boligområde. Kampene fortsetter nær Jemens by Taiz mens FN oppfordrer til humanitær tilgang. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Jordan resumed airstrikes in southern Syria targeting Daesh, prompting Syrian condemnation and reports of civilian casualties, while a joint security committee and investigation into the strikes were agreed between the two states and the Nasib border crossing reopened. Syrian security forces killed a French jihadist in Harem and another French fighter in Idlib, and unidentified gunmen killed two Syrian defence ministry personnel in Idlib. Heavy rain and flash floods across Syria killed five people, including four children. Syria announced the release of 57 prisoners transferred from Lebanon and joined an Arab anti-drug conference in Tunisia to boost regional cooperation. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Prime Minister Al-Zaidi has taken direct control of Iraq's intelligence service while Iran has stepped up pressure on Baghdad over PJAK armed presence. Al-Zaidi's visit to Damascus revived the Sharaa pipeline dispute but also moved forward talks on border security and oil exports, prompting the parliamentary security committee to consider funding for enhanced air-defence systems. Iraqi security agencies arrested nine suspects on human-trafficking charges and a parliamentarian was sentenced for illegal oil contracts. The Kurdistan region deepened security coordination with Baghdad and advanced weapons-control measures. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks sikkerhetsbyråer arresterte ni mistenkte på anklager om menneskehandel, og en parlamentariker ble dømt for ulovlige oljekontrakter. Kurdistan-regionen styrket sikkerhetskoordineringen med Bagdad og fremmet tiltak for våpenkontroll. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Sudanese army is accused of launching 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, a claim Ethiopia denies. A UN agency reports that nearly 120,000 people have been displaced in Blue Nile state since January. The UAE federal court sentenced eight Sudanese defendants to life imprisonment for illegal arms trafficking to the Sudanese army, and there were 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den sudanske hæren blir anklaget for å ha gjennomført 162 dronavspark fra etiopisk territorium, en påstand Etiopia benekter. Et FN-byrå rapporterer at nesten 120 000 personer har blitt fordrevet i delstaten Blue Nile siden januar. Den føderale domstolen i De forente arabiske emirater dømte åtte sudanske til livsstraff for ulovlig våpenhandel med den sudanske hæren, og det var 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In the Upper Nile region, fighting since March 2025 has displaced 125,000 people and killed 180, prompting a UN envoy to call for consensus among leaders. Opposition leader Machar continues to dispute Bol Mel’s claims over the Nasir attack, while Odinga has appealed for international intervention after meeting President Kiir. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Upper Nile-regionen har kamper siden mars 2025 fordrevet 125 000 mennesker og drept 180, noe som fikk en FN-utsending til å kreve konsensus blant lederne. Opposisjonslederen Machar fortsetter å bestride Bol Mel sine påstander om angrepet på Nasir, mens Odinga har bedt om internasjonal inngripen etter møte med president Kiir. approved.en: Russian Su-35 fighter jets and S-400 air defence systems have arrived in Ethiopia as fighting spreads across Tigray, Amhara and Oromia, with drone strikes hitting an IDP camp in Amhara and a shelter in South Wollo, causing civilian casualties. Militant attackers killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in Oromia, while drone strikes in Amhara killed 14, including children. Thousands of people are fleeing the border clashes, with about 50,000 refugees arriving in Moyale, Kenya. The conflict has also seen Ethiopia begin homegrown drone manufacturing. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Al Shabaab fighters are intensifying attacks on Turkish-trained Somali troops in Lower Shabelle and ambushing units near Baidoa, while Somali intelligence killed a former al-Shabaab finance chief in Lower Shabelle. African Union peacekeepers are withdrawing from four bases in Lower Shabelle and Ethiopia is pulling more than 3,000 troops from Somalia amid fighting at home, reducing external military presence. The federal government has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF-17 fighter jets, the United States has imposed entry conditions on ships calling at Somali ports, and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against Al Shabaab in nearly a year. Piracy off Somalia’s coast is rising, with hijacked oil tankers and hostages reported, and the conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Fredsstyrker fra Den afrikanske union trekker seg tilbake fra fire baser i Lower Shabelle, og Etiopia trekker mer enn 3 000 soldater fra Somalia på grunn av kamper hjemme, noe som reduserer den utenlandske militære tilstedeværelsen. Den føderale regjeringen har gått med på å anskaffe pakistanske JF‑17‑jagerfly, USA har innført innreisekrav for skip som legger til kai i somaliske havner, og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneangrep mot al Shabaab på nesten ett år. Piratvirksomhet utenfor Somalias kyst øker, med kaprede oljetankskip og rapporterte gisler, og konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Mali forces have retaken Kidal as jihadist attacks intensify, and a Mali drone strike killed 13 civilians while claiming to target militants. In Niger, a convoy carrying Governor Bago collided with a car, killing four students, a driver and a young woman, and Niger accused Chad of a drone attack that killed two civilians. Algeria has deployed troops to Niger to protect energy assets, its first foreign mission in over 50 years. Militants now control at least 40% of Burkina Faso, a critic of Mali’s junta was forcibly disappeared, and the junta stripped five more exiled critics of nationality. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Algerie har sendt tropper til Niger for å beskytte energianlegg, sin første utenlandske operasjon på over 50 år. Militante kontrollerer nå minst 40 % av Burkina Faso, en kritiker av Malis junta ble tvangsforsvunnet, og junten fratok fem ytterligere eksilkritikere nasjonalitet. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen killed seven civilians in a Plateau community and shot Islamic cleric Yahaya Masussuka dead in Katsina, while troops killed 44 terror suspects in Borno and disrupted an IED attack. Bandits released an abducted Kaduna family after a N300m ransom demand and were later accused by the PRP of failing leadership, while a false claim about a Zamfara student abduction was debunked. Troops captured bandits' logistics suppliers in Benue, foiled an attack on Miong village in Plateau, and repelled a terrorist assault in Benue, recovering two AK-47 rifles. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Banditter slapp en bortført familie fra Kaduna etter et løsepengerkrav på N300 m og ble senere anklaget av PRP for sviktende ledelse, mens et falskt påstand om en bortføring av en student i Zamfara ble avkreftet. Tropper fanget bandittenes logistikkleverandører i Benue, avverget et angrep på landsbyen Miong på Plateau, og avviste et terrorangrep i Benue, og gjenvant to AK‑47‑rifler. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The 92‑year-old federal judge who oversaw the Maduro drug-trafficking case has died and a new judge has been appointed to continue the trial, while Maduro is returning to federal court to face torture allegations. A soldier allegedly bet $400,000 on Maduro’s removal and has been arrested, and another soldier faces a Polymarket insider-trading investigation. Explosive attacks near the Colombia-Venezuela border injured police officers and civilians in two separate blasts. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2007.
approved.nb: Den 92‑årige føderale dommeren som ledet Maduro-saken om narkotikasmugling, er død, og en ny dommer er utnevnt for å fortsette rettssaken, mens Maduro vender tilbake til føderal domstol for å møte anklager om tortur. En soldat skal ha satset 400 000 dollar på Maduros avsettelse og er blitt arrestert, og en annen soldat står overfor en etterforskning av innsidehandel på Polymarket. Eksplosive angrep nær grensen mellom Colombia og Venezuela såret politibetjenter og sivile i to separate eksplosjoner. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2007.
